data.text: Count me in for 10 tons. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next season, and this agreement does that while giving each of us a living. Luke, you’re welcome here as an equal—there’s no need to sit out. Let’s make 50 tons our shared ceiling while the lake is full and check the stock and everyone’s catches each month. John, will you join us, and Luke, would you accept an equal 10-ton share?
